function disableClonesFocus(host): void

Defined in: website/components/carousel/awards-carousel/observer.ts:80

Keyboard/AT exclusion for clone slides: they're visual duplicates that exist only for the loop illusion, so every focusable inside them is tabindex−1 + aria-hidden — tab order and screen readers traverse the real slides exactly once. Re-run after every render since clones are re-created with the DOM.

Parameters

host

AwardsCarousel

The AwardsCarousel element.

void
